description_en: Queries the list of cloud services added to Web Application Firewall (WAF)
description_zh: 查询接入到WAF的云产品列表情况
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-cloud-resources --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-lbj0000cn0c --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCloudResources

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource instance
parameters.name: resource_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the resource instance
parameters.name: resource_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the resource resides. For more information, see the "Regions and supported products" section in this topic.

Each cloud service supports different regions. If you specify the ResourceProduct parameter, make sure the region you specify for this parameter supports that service. Otherwise, the query may fail
parameters.help_zh:
资源归属地域ID，取值请查看返回参数补充说明。

每个产品支持的地域不同，产品筛选字段有值时，需要参考地域支持的产品，否则可能导致筛选失败
parameters.name: resource_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The cloud service to which the resource belongs. By default, instances of Application Load Balancer (ALB), Microservices Engine (MSE), Function Compute (FC), and Serverless App Engine (SAE) are returned. Valid values:

alb: ALB

mse: MSE

fc: FC

sae: SAE

ecs: Elastic Compute Service (ECS)

clb4: Classic Load Balancer (CLB) that uses TCP

clb7: CLB that uses HTTP or HTTPS

nlb: Network Load Balancer (NLB)

Each cloud service supports different regions. If you specify this parameter, make sure the region you specify for the ResourceRegionId parameter supports this service. Otherwise, the query may fail
parameters.help_zh:
资源所属云产品，默认返回ALB、MSE、FC和SAE产品的实例，取值：

alb：表示ALB产品。

mse：表示MSE产品。

fc：表示FC产品。

sae：表示SAE产品。

ecs：表示ECS产品。
clb4：表示CLB(TCP)产品。
clb7：表示CLB(HTTP/HTTPS)产品。
nlb：表示NLB产品。

每个产品支持的地域不同，产品筛选字段有值时，需要参考地域支持的产品，否则可能导致筛选失败
parameters.name: resource_product

parameters.help_zh: 分页查询请求时返回的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数。默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the route. This parameter is available when you query MSE resources
parameters.help_zh: 资源的路由名称，当MSE接入可以使用该字段查询
parameters.name: resource_route_name

parameters.help_en: The domain name of the resource. This parameter is available when you query FC or SAE resources
parameters.help_zh: 资源的域名名称，当FC，SAE接入可以使用该字段查询
parameters.name: resource_domain

parameters.help_en: The name of the function. This parameter is available when you query FC resources
parameters.help_zh: 资源的函数名称，当FC接入可以使用该字段查询
parameters.name: resource_function

parameters.help_en: The UID of the account to which the resource belongs
parameters.name: owner_user_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the instance that is added to WAF
parameters.name: resource_instance_name

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

This parameter is returned only for ECS and CLB instances
